_comment: Editorial config for the hero 'day in my world' illustration. This file is EDITORIAL ONLY — it decides which activities represent the routine, their order and timing, and which project/role each scene points to. It never states dates or statuses itself; those live in data/experience.json (the single source of truth) and are looked up here by id. To change what the illustration shows: toggle 'enabled', reorder 'order', edit 'duration' (ms), or change 'captionOverride'. To change the featured build, edit currentProject below — it is never guessed from the newest project card.
